source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 6 and SAEngine practice (see sources)

prestress.note: Owner decisions 2026-11-01. Sec 9.12.2 sends the punching shear of prestressed slabs to Chapter 6, which has no prestress term: punchingMethod 'reinforced' (the Chapter 6 vc, no precompression benefit; the punching* numbers stay for packs that choose 'precompression'). Sec 9.5.1 (c) asks for bonded bars to carry the whole tension at transfer above 0.25/0.50 √f'ci but prints no stress for them: transferBonded.stressShare 0.5 fy (the Eq 6.9.9 stress) and the ends of a simply supported strip taken as within endRegion × h of its anchors are SAEngine practice, not BNBC. Sec 9.12.7 prints As >= 1.5 × Eq 6.9.12 and >= 2.1 bw d / fy: both are applied as printed. The 12.7 mm integrity strand of Sec 9.12.6 is stored as its area 98.7 mm² (the model keeps the strand area), and the region bounded by the column bars as the column section less coreInset 40 mm each side: SAEngine practice. Bursting: BNBC Sec 9.13.4.1 (c) permits simplified equations and Sec 9.15.1 adopts AASHTO LRFD (SI) 2007 Art. 5.10.9.6 for them without printing them: T = share × Ppu (1 - a/h), d = depthShare × (h - 2e) (Art. 5.10.9.6.3), adopted by reference.

sources.aggregates: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 5.13.2.1-5.13.2.2 (p. 856): Ec of stone and brick aggregate concrete; Sec 6.1.8.1 (p. 893): λ = 0.85 sand-lightweight, 0.75 all-lightweight, 1.0 normal weight (brick aggregate concrete is normal weight); Sec 8.1.11.2 (b) (p. 1075): shrinkage and temperature steel of brick aggregate concrete × 1.5
sources.modulus: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.1.7.1 (p. 892) and 5.13.2.1 (p. 856): Ec = 0.043 wc^1.5 √f'c for wc 1440-2560 kg/m³ (5.13.2.1 prints the same as 44 wc^1.5 √f'c, wc 15-25 kN/m³), 4700 √f'c for normal weight; Sec 5.13.2.2 (p. 856): 3750 √f'c for brick aggregate
sources.shrinkage: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 8.1.11.2 (a), (c) (p. 1075): 0.0020 for fy 275 and 350 MPa, 0.0018 for 420 MPa, 0.0018 × 420 / fy above 420, never below 0.0014 (the spacing of 8.1.11.2 (c), 5h and 450 mm, is slabCoefficients.maxSpacing.temperature). The clause prints no ratio between 350 and 420 MPa: 0.0020 is kept up to 420 (the more conservative of the two neighbours, owner decision 2026-11-01)

sources.prestress: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 9 (part 1 pp. 1139-1159): Sec 9.4.3 (p. 1139) classes U, T, C (0.62 and 1.0 √f'c; two-way slabs Class U, 0.50 √f'c); Sec 9.4.5.4 (p. 1140) fr = 0.62 λ √f'c; Sec 9.5.1 (p. 1141) transfer 0.60 f'ci, 0.70 f'ci at the ends of simply supported members, bonded bars above 0.50 √f'ci at those ends and 0.25 √f'ci elsewhere; service 0.45 f'c sustained, 0.60 f'c total; Sec 9.5.4 (p. 1142) jacking 0.94 fpy and 0.80 fpu, after transfer 0.82 fpy and 0.74 fpu, at the anchors 0.70 fpu; Sec 9.6.5 Table 6.9.2 (p. 1144) relaxation 0, 35, 70, 90 MPa at 0.5-0.8 fpu; Sec 9.8.2 (p. 1148) Eqs 6.9.5-6.9.7, γp 0.55, 0.40, 0.28 for fpy/fpu >= 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, fse >= 0.5 fpu, unbonded fse + 70 + f'c/(100 ρp) <= fpy, fse + 420 up to span/depth 35, else f'c/(300 ρp), fse + 210; Sec 9.9.3 (p. 1150) 1.2 × the cracking load, waived at twice the required strength; Sec 9.9.4 (pp. 1150-1151) Eq 6.9.8 0.004 Act, Eq 6.9.9 Nc / (0.5 fy) above 0.17 √f'c with fy <= 420 MPa, Eq 6.9.10 0.00075 Acf within 1.5h of the column faces, at least four bars at most 300 mm apart, lengths ln/3 and ln/6; Sec 9.11.2-9.11.3 (pp. 1152-1153) 1.6 MPa, ties >= No. 10 at <= 48 tie diameters, Eq 6.9.11 ρs = 0.45 (Ag/Ach - 1) f'c/fyt, fyt <= 700 MPa; Sec 9.12.4 (p. 1154) 0.9 MPa, 8h and 1.5 m; Sec 9.12.6-9.12.7 (p. 1155) two 12.7 mm strands each way at the columns, else 1.5 × Eq 6.9.12 (0.25 √f'c bw d / fy) and 2.1 bw d / fy of bottom bars; Sec 9.13.2.2 (p. 1156) Ppu = 1.2 × the jacking force, Sec 9.9.2 (d) φ 0.85; Sec 9.13.4.7 (p. 1158) 2 % of Ppu against spalling (not for monostrand slab tendons); Sec 9.13.5.3 (p. 1158) f'ci >= 28 MPa multi-strand, 17 MPa single strand; Sec 9.14.2 (pp. 1159-1160) two 12 mm edge bars within h/2 ahead of the anchors, 150 mm beyond the outer ones, groups of six or more at <= 300 mm: n + 1 No. 10 hairpins 3h/8 to h/2 ahead. Punching with prestress (punching*) is not BNBC (Sec 9.12.2 uses Chapter 6) and is kept for other packs only
